title: Parallel fetch, at most k at a time, in order
prompt:
Write `Crawl(urls []string, k int, fetch func(url string) int) []int`.

- Call `fetch` once per URL, with at most `k` calls running at the same time.
- Return the results in input order, even though calls finish out of order.
- An empty list gives an empty (non-nil) slice.

`["a", "b", "c"]`, k = 2 → `[fetch("a") fetch("b") fetch("c")]`.
hint: Preallocate the result and let each goroutine write its own index; a buffered channel of size `k` is the semaphore.
